boxery — remote desktop VMs for coding agents

Usage:
  boxery [--host NAME] COMMAND [ARGS...]

Setup & hosts:
  setup user@host|local         Configure a VM host (local = this machine), register your ssh key
  host add|ls|show|use|rm       Manage named hosts (host use sets the default)
  build-base                    Build the host's desktop base image (one time, ~3 min)

VMs:
  ls                            List VMs: every host's, a section each (--host NAME: one)
  new NAME                      Create a VM
  start NAME                    Start a stopped VM (pins its ssh host key where it can)
  stop NAME                     Stop a VM
  rm NAME                       Destroy a VM and its snapshots (revokes its LLM token)
  resize NAME                   Change a VM's size (restarts it if running; disk only grows)
  fork SRC DST...               Copy a VM (running or not) into new VMs, ~10 s
  patch NAME|--all              Update a VM's guest software to the host's image layers
  pin NAME                      Re-pin a VM's ssh host key (VMs made before keys were pinned)
  shapes                        VM sizes defined on the host (* = default)

Snapshots & images:
  snap NAME [SNAP]              Snapshot a VM's disk (Lima restarts a running VM)
  snaps NAME                    List a VM's snapshots
  revert NAME SNAP              Restore a VM to a snapshot (keeps its name, address and token)
  snap-rm NAME SNAP             Delete a snapshot
  images                        Every snapshot on the host (new NAME --from VM@SNAP uses one)

Work in a VM:
  ssh NAME [CMD...]             Shell into a VM (also: ssh NAME.boxery)
  run NAME CMD [ARG...]         Run a command in ~/project, args as given (like docker exec)
  cp FROM TO                    Copy files and directories to, from and between VMs
  desktop NAME                  Open a VM's desktop in your browser (noVNC over ssh)
  forward NAME PORT [LOCAL]     Forward a VM port to localhost
  attach NAME [AGENT]           Attach to an agent in a persistent tmux session
  prompt NAME "TASK"            Start a headless pi task in its own tmux session
  sessions NAME                 List a VM's tmux sessions

Background jobs:
  jobs NAME                     List background jobs (run --bg starts one)
  logs NAME JOB                 Show a job's output (the last 200 lines)
  wait NAME JOB                 Wait for a job; exits with its exit code
  kill NAME JOB                 Stop a job: SIGTERM its process group, then SIGKILL

Access (grants):
  grant NAME SPEC...            Give a VM access to something on this machine (asks first)
  revoke NAME SPEC...|all       Take access away (pushed values are deleted from the VM)
  grants NAME [apply]           Show a VM's grants, or push them again (apply)
  agent-forward NAME on|off     Same as grant/revoke NAME ssh-agent

Shared pool & runners:
  acquire                       Lease a VM from the shared pool (prints NAME LEASE_ID)
  renew NAME                    Extend your lease
  release NAME                  Give a leased VM back (it is reset to its clean snapshot)
  leases                        Your leases
  pool add|rm|ls                Manage the shared pool of leasable VMs (admin)
  runners once|status|...       GitHub Actions runners on pool VMs

Host & diagnostics:
  version                       Controller and host versions; warns when the host is behind
  upgrade-host                  Update boxery on the host and restart its services
  backends                      Backend support, requirements and capabilities
  capabilities                  The selected host's platform and capabilities
  backend                       The host's VM backend (recorded for host ls)
  proxy-log [N]                 Recent LLM and edge (http: grant) requests on the host
  help [COMMAND]                Show help for boxery or a command

Options:
  --host NAME                   Run COMMAND on a host other than the default (boxery host use)
  --json                        JSON output on listings (fields: docs/cli.md#json-output)
  -h, --help                    Show help; boxery COMMAND --help shows a command's

Docs: https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/cli.md
Agents: prefer the vm_* tools (boxery-mcp or the pi extension): https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/mcp.md
